text_block_list.text: Summer training camp kicks off. A refreshing season of youth and sweat has arrived, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? What the hell is this data?!
Don't go handin' me half-assed numbers!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's not random. It's potentialâpure potential!
This very margin of error is what brings about evolution, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, alright, alright, don't fight, don't fight.
Seems like we can't really reach an agreement here...

Transcend was deep in conversation with two people
who didn't seem very youthful...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Air Shakur.
She has a knack for numbers and can handle
programming and systems architecture all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you don't get it at all.
Evolution is always born
from unforeseen miscalculations.

This Umamusume is Agnes Tachyon.
A mad scientist who's always carrying out
suspicious experiments.
choice_data_list: Tran, why are you with these two...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Aah...? What's this crap?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, shall I make you glow too?
Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah, the reason I called these two is complicated—super complicated~. Basically, the two of them are...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: We're "co-developers," after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Truth is, if we wanna keep winning from here on out, we absolutely have to..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that we need
to develop 'a certain gadget.'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: And to finish it, you need specialized technicians in every field.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, that is how it is.
In other words, this Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was asked to lend my expertise
in my specialtyâbiology... and that's that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And I'm in charge of the system
that processes the collected data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not that I'm helping out of the goodness of my heart, though.
The data obtained from this work will be――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll feed the data back into each of our research.
Yes, a win-win, truly a win-win.

A bunch of Umamusume who won't be easily handled.
Yet, there seems to be a solid reason for gathering them here.
choice_data_list: So, what kind of gadget is it?
So, what kind of gadget is it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, you'll just have to wait and see until it's finished.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "I think it'll be finished by the end of this summer, so look forward to it! With that said—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Please continue, you two.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"So during the implementation stage,
we need something more reliable, I say!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about "certainty"?! It's all about dreams! Dreams!
Science is made of dreams!

To build a mysterious gadget,
Transcend took the lead of the development team.
Just what kind of creation will it turn out to be?
